title: ​​​​What’s new in Microsoft Security: November 2026
description: This Microsoft Security update from November 2026 introduces new capabilities to manage and contain AI agents and improve endpoint privilege management. Key features include Dynamic Permissions for task-scoped agent authority, Microsoft Execution Containers for OS-enforced containment of AI agents, expanded least-privilege controls via Microsoft Intune Endpoint Privilege Management, and enhanced visibility and management of local AI agents through Microsoft Defender. The update also simplifies SQL Server protection deployment in Azure Government and improves security posture prioritization with Microsoft Security Exposure Management. These enhancements aim to reduce risk by limiting AI agent authority, adapting access dynamically based on risk, and providing security teams with clearer insights and expert-led protection.
